India's women cricketers achieve historic Test win at Lord's

India's women's cricket team secured a significant victory in the first-ever women's Test match played at Lord's. The event saw record attendance for a women's Test, highlighting the growing popularity and evolution of the sport. The team's performance, marked by strong strategy and teamwork, has drawn comparisons to the men's team.
